LanguageData.ShamblerArms_NonUnoPinataActive: Non Uno Pinata is active: item dropping is controlled by its settings.
LanguageData.ShamblerArms_NoAnomaly: Requires Anomaly; has no effect without it.
LanguageData.ShamblerArms_IntellectLevelTip: Average intellect of a newly raised shambler.
LanguageData.ShamblerArms_IntellectSpreadTip: Each shambler gets a random value within level ± spread. Applies to shamblers raised from now on.
LanguageData.ShamblerArms_TierHelp: Below 25%: mindless, drops its weapon. 25%+: brawler, keeps melee weapons. 50%+: gunner, shoots from short range. 75%+: tactician, uses cover and picks up weapons on its way.
LanguageData.ShamblerArms_PickupRadiusTip: Tacticians pick up the best weapon within this radius. Reduced in proportion to sight: damaged or missing eyes see less, a blind shambler picks up nothing.
LanguageData.ShamblerArms_HandsHelp: A shambler needs a working arm with a hand to hold a weapon, and two for two-handed weapons (rifles, bows, spears, hammers). Without enough hands it drops the weapon when it rises, won't pick one up, and drops the weapon it holds if it loses an arm or hand in combat.
